title: Quick Chili Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A light and flavorful Mexican dish featuring shortcrust pastry, soffritto-base, and a hint of chili. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless, cut into small pieces

instructions: Roll out the shortcrust pastry and place in a 9x13 inch Dutch oven.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder, and cumin to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and stir to combine.
Spoon the chicken mixture into the pastry-lined Dutch oven and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Remove the foil and sprinkle with shredded cheese. Return to oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
